يضطبنا (form VIII)
# يَضْطَبِنَا (yaḍṭabinā) /jadˤ.tˤa.bi.naː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# يُضْطَبَنَا (yuḍṭabanā) /judˤ.tˤa.ba.naː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
